locator.excerpt: ## Why it matters This idea connects dashboard design, agent participation, and knowledge organization.  An archive becomes more useful when it is reopened as a worktable rather than left as a warehouse. The point is not to keep adding items to a static list, but to spread out the capture, reclassify what changed, and pull reusable pieces back into active work.  When the material is mixed media, the visible surface has to come first. A photo set, a 9-frame storyboard, or a batch of captures is easier to reuse when the order is fixed before generation, not after it.
